description: Convert a Markdown article into an X (Twitter) thread, and optionally post it with its images attached. X renders no rich text and cannot carry an image in a paste, so the equivalent of a "paste payload" is a numbered thread script plus an API path that uploads each image and posts the thread in order. Counting follows X's weighted rules: 1 per character, 2 for CJK and emoji, 23 per URL. Use when the user wants to publish a markdown draft to X or Twitter, asks for a thread, asks how to get an article's images onto X, or wants a long article turned into posts.
